title: Social Chat
description: Social Chat enhances the default Minecraft chat experience. Adds mentions (@player, @everyone) with sound notifications and emojis
body:
**Social Chat** is a lightweight client-side mod that makes chatting in Minecraft more modern and interactive.

## Features

### @Mentions

Type `@` to see a list of online players, as well as `@everyone`.

Mentioning a player (`@Player`) or everyone (`@everyone`) sends them a notification sound, making it easier to get someone's attention even if they're busy.

### Emoji Autocomplete

Type `:` to open an emoji picker.

Social Chat doesn't include emoji textures by default. Instead, it uses Minecraft's built-in emoji system, allowing you to install any compatible resource pack and customize their appearance however you like.

### Typing Status *(Server Required)*

When the mod is installed on both the client and the server, players can see when others are typing.

Examples:

* `Steve is typing...`
* `Alex and Steve are typing...`
* `3 players are typing...`

This feature is synchronized through the server and is the only functionality that requires the server to have the mod installed.

## Client-Side

All core features—including mentions, notifications, and emoji autocomplete—work entirely on the client. Servers do **not** need to install Social Chat unless they want to enable typing indicators.

Social Chat is designed to improve communication while remaining lightweight, simple, and fully compatible with vanilla gameplay.
